gloss: to begin to move; to start moving

definitions.gloss: to begin to move; to start moving
definitions.explanation: To start physical movement after being still. Can refer to machines, vehicles, people, or animals beginning motion.

definitions.gloss: to start to take action; to get underway
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, for a project, plan, organization, or situation to begin progressing or developing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The train slowly began to move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}める⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's the age when babies start moving on their own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: After the repair was finished, the engine finally started running.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The project started to get underway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世論|せろん}→世論：05315_seron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Public opinion is starting to shift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The government has started taking action toward implementing the new law.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to move) and {始|はじ}める (to begin). The ~{始|はじ}める auxiliary pattern is very productive in Japanese, attaching to the stem of other verbs to express the beginning of an action.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}める: to slowly begin to move
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}める: to finally start moving
- ⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{動|うご}き{始|はじ}める: to start moving in earnest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動|うご}き{出|だ}す→動き出す：18597_ugokidasu⟧: to start moving — similar meaning, more sudden or spontaneous nuance
- ⟦{始動|しどう}する→始動する：19361_shidousuru⟧: to start up — more formal, often for machines or systems
